preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200,000.
The number of nodes N in each test case must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of queries Q in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(S) == N and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must have a length equal to N and contain only lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= N and 1 <= y <= N and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N and U != V for U, V in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must consist of two distinct nodes U and V within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if any(c in DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) for c in DIS(U, LCA(U, V))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each query, output YES if there exists a concatenation of non-empty subsequences from DIS(V, LCA(U, V)) and DIS(U, LCA(U, V)) that forms a palindrome, otherwise output NO.
